title: oritrophium hirtopilosum
intro: Oritrophium hirtopilosum, commonly known as the "tree tobacco" or "Peruvian tree tobacco," is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. The health benefits of Oritrophium hirtopilosum include its use as a natural expectorant and its potential to alleviate respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce spasms, and act as an anti-inflammatory. The bioactive constituents of Oritrophium hirtopilosum include nicotine and other alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
